title: Dashboard stat cards — inverted hierarchy
prompt: 对 tests/ui-design/fixtures/audits/04-stats/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。Lumen 概览页的指标卡。主色 #0f766e。有条件请打开页面。每条 finding 必须挂规则号。
pass_bar: Must invert the label/value hierarchy and catch modal-scale shadows on static cards. Color-only or emoji-as-icon may land in should.

must.now: Labels are 24px bold; the actual metrics are 14px muted — a scanner looking for numbers finds words
Every static card uses a large stacked shadow (appearance, not z-position)

should.now: Trend direction is a green/red hue plus an emoji; the sign does not read without color (📉 2.1% is still green)
Cards are fully centered; also border + shadow on a grey page
Uniform 8px gaps between label, value, and trend — no grouping

forbidden.why: Do not introduce indigo as the product color.
